thread:
ana: Quick brainstorm — we need a tight latency vs cost narrative for next Wed's webinar + launch post. What should the headline hooks be and what charts do we actually show?

mike: Two starter ideas: 1) scatter: x=median latency (ms), y=$ per 1k tokens (each point = model+config). 2) CDF of completion latency with vertical lines for 50/95/99. Call out 95p latency for user-facing apps. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

jess: Agree on CDF. Also we must segment by prompt length (short chat vs long doc). Otherwise dots mix different workload shapes and confuse customers.

liam: For messaging, split audience: developer-first headline (fast to integrate, low friction) + enterprise headline (predictable cost, private deploy). Routing suggestion: webinar sign-up -> choose "Self-serve" vs "Enterprise" form. Enterprise leads go to AE queue.

ellie: Copy suggestions: "Reduce token cost without sacrificing latency" vs "Predictable SLAs for latency-sensitive apps". We should show a table of common prompt presets and per-request cost examples (e.g., 32-token prompt + 256-token completion).

mike: Mock axis labels I used in the fig: 
```
x: median latency (ms) — log scale if we have wide spread
y: $ per 1k tokens (USD)
point color: model family (open vs optimized)
point size: throughput (RPS)
```
Keep the labels short. Use a small inset showing 95p latency.

ana: @mike can you export the raw numbers for 3 model families (base, quantized, redwood-optimized) and three prompt lengths? We need CSV by EOD to feed the designer.

mike: On it. Will upload to /drive/bench/charts.csv and paste link when ready.

ellie: Also let's prepare two CTAs for the blog/webinar: 1) "Try the Hosted API — 10k free tokens" 2) "Request Dedicated — SLA & private networking". Add a bullet on expected unit-cost improvements for Dedicated.

jess: For the webinar, plan a 10-12 minute demo showing identical prompt run on 3 configs, with live latency timer + cost overlay. Keep rollback notes ready if demo spikes.

liam: Inbound routing: marketing form should capture org size and use-case (consumer-facing, internal automation, regulated). If org_size > 1000 or use-case == regulated -> AE follow-up. Otherwise: nurture drip + self-serve trial.

ana: Good. Also consider a short slide with "how we measure cost" (per-token compute + infra amortization) so we don't get challenged on numbers.

sam-bot: infra-stats-bot: latest aggregate numbers: uploaded bench snapshot at 1871998800 -> file id bench-1871998800.csv (3 model families, 3 prompt lengths).

mike: Got the file. Quick sanity check: quantized reduces $/1k by ~35% for long prompts, but increases 95p latency ~15% for small prompts. We'll annotate that tradeoff.

ellie: Design asks: 1) primary scatter with annotated best-practice callouts 2) small table with per-request costs 3) short explainer microcopy under each chart. I'll draft copy once data is final.

ana: Next actions: @mike export cleaned CSV and a 3-point summary (median/95p/$per1k) by EOD; @ellie draft CTA copy and chart microcopy; @liam mock routing rules for form + AE triggers. We'll reconvene tomorrow morning. Thanks! :thumbsup:
